## Summary

A `solve --tool agent --model formal-ai` run on
[formal-ai#927](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/pull/927) died 22
seconds in and published exactly one artefact — a "🚨 Solution Draft Failed"
comment whose entire diagnosis was:

```text
AGENT execution failed with Agent reported error: [object Object]
```

`--attach-logs` was off, so that string is the only surviving record of the run
and the real cause is unrecoverable. `@link-assistant/agent` emits
`NamedError.toObject()` — `{"type":"error","error":{"name":"…","data":{"message":"…"}}}`
— and `src/agent.lib.mjs` interpolated that object into a template literal.
The `|| JSON.stringify(msg)` fallback that would have preserved the diagnosis
was unreachable, because the object is truthy.

Fixes #2141.

## How to reproduce

```bash
node experiments/issue-2141/reproduce-object-object.mjs
```

```
BEFORE
  published reason  : AGENT execution failed with Agent reported error: [object Object]   ← issue #2141
AFTER
  published reason  : AGENT execution failed with Agent reported error: RetryTimeoutExceededError: Retry timeout exceeded after 604800s
```

The upstream probes that produced the raw NDJSON evidence:
`bash experiments/issue-2141/probe-agent-cli.sh`.

## What changed

- **`src/error-text.lib.mjs` (new)** — one shared renderer for strings, `Error`
  instances, `NamedError` `{name, data:{message}}` payloads, nested
  `{error:{…}}` envelopes and arrays. Circular-safe, depth-limited, truncated at
  2000 chars, never returns a placeholder. A *single* implementation is the
  point: `qwen.lib.mjs` already had correct logic, in a private copy the other
  five adapters could not see.
- **Nine call sites, six files** — a codebase-wide audit
  ([`analysis/adapter-audit.md`](./docs/case-studies/issue-2141/analysis/adapter-audit.md))
  found the same defect class in `agent` (×2), `claude` (×2), `codex`, `gemini`,
  `qwen`, `interactive-codex-events` and `cancelled-ci-rerun`. All now use the
  shared renderer.
  **One was not cosmetic:** `codex.lib.mjs` guarded `error` / `turn.failed`
  events with `typeof data.message === 'string'`, so an object-shaped
  `turn.failed` was **discarded** and the run reported as a success.
- **Defence in depth** — `isMeaningfulErrorText` / `extractToolErrorCore` in
  `src/lib.mjs` now reject a core polluted by `[object Object]`, so any site the
  audit missed degrades to the honest `AGENT execution failed`.
- **Fail fast on a silent startup failure** — agent CLI 0.25.5 exits **0** with
  **zero** error events when the model cannot be initialised
  (`ProviderModelNotFoundError`), which Hive Mind read as a successful empty run.
  `detectFatalAgentLogRecord` now catches the log record and fails the run — but
  only when the CLI also produced no text output, preserving the #1276 recovery
  semantics.
- **Diagnostics (verbose mode)** — the raw JSON of every error record and fatal
  log record is now logged under `--verbose`, so the next incident carries its
  own evidence even if a future payload shape defeats the renderer.
- **The failure comment is actionable** — when logs were not attached it now says
  that this comment is the only surviving record and to rerun with
  `--attach-logs --verbose`.

## Tests

- `tests/test-issue-2141-error-text.mjs` (new) — 26 tests over the helper, five
  adapters, the publishing path and the failure comment, all asserting the
  absence of `[object Object]` on the **verbatim** agent CLI 0.25.5 payload
  shapes.
- `tests/test-agent-error-detection.mjs` now imports the real detector instead of
  a local copy of it — that copy is why this defect was invisible to the suite.
- Full default suite (378 files): passing. `npm run lint` and
  `prettier --check`: clean.

## Case study (issue requirement)

[`docs/case-studies/issue-2141/`](./docs/case-studies/issue-2141/README.md) —
timeline, root causes RC1–RC6, each of the 14 issue requirements mapped to where
it is addressed, a survey of existing components (`util.inspect`,
`serialize-error`, `pretty-error`, RFC 9457, typescript-eslint's
`restrict-template-expressions`) and why the in-repo helper was the right call,
plus `raw/` (issue/PR/comment JSON, agent CLI source excerpts, 583-record probe
NDJSON) and `analysis/`.

The original run log could not be recovered: `--attach-logs` was off and the
container is gone. That fact is itself RC4.

## Upstream reports filed

| Repository                                                                  | Report                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`agent#289`](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/issues/289)           | JSON `error` events carry an object with no human-readable field — with the three-line `run.ts` patch that would fix it     |
| [`agent#290`](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/issues/290)           | Fatal startup errors exit 0 with no error event (recurrence of `agent#22`), plus `ConnectionRefused` retried for 7 days     |
| [`formal-ai#973`](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/issues/973)   | Run automated `solve` sessions with `--attach-logs --verbose` so failures leave evidence the learning loop can act on       |

Each includes a runnable reproduction, the observed vs expected behaviour, a
code-level fix suggestion and the consumer-side workaround now shipped here.

commits.messageBody:
Adding .gitkeep for PR creation (default mode).
This file will be removed when the task is complete.

Issue: https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/issues/2141

Agentic CLIs publish errors as objects (@link-assistant/agent emits
NamedError.toObject() = {name, data}). Every adapter interpolated that
payload into a template literal, so the reason published to GitHub was
"AGENT execution failed with Agent reported error: [object Object]" and
the diagnosis was lost.

- add src/error-text.lib.mjs, a shared renderer for string/Error/NamedError/
  nested-envelope payloads that never yields [object Object]
- route the agent, claude, qwen and codex adapters through it
- guard the downstream formatter (isMeaningfulErrorText/extractToolErrorCore)
  so a polluted core is dropped instead of published
- detect the silent startup failure where the agent CLI exits 0 after
  ProviderModelNotFoundError with no error event
- log the raw error/log records under --verbose, and tell the user to rerun
  with --attach-logs --verbose in the pre-PR failure comment
- regression tests + a runnable reproduction under experiments/issue-2141
commits.messageHeadline: fix(2141): render structured tool error payloads as readable text

commits.messageBody:
…un comments

Codebase-wide audit of the same defect class:
- codex: `typeof data.message === 'string'` silently dropped object-shaped
  `error` / `turn.failed` events, so an object-shaped turn failure read as a
  success; render them with firstErrorText instead
- gemini: error payloads fell back to a raw JSON dump
- cancelled-CI review comment: a re-run failure carrying an Error object would
  have been published as [object Object]
commits.messageHeadline: fix(2141): apply the readable-error rule to codex, gemini and CI re-r…
